intuition: Matching always consumes the oldest active rider and oldest available driver.

brute_force.approach: Store riders and drivers in lists and remove matched or canceled entries by search.

optimal.approach: Use FIFO deques and an active-rider set; skip canceled riders lazily when they reach the front.

edge_cases: A match is unavailable unless both queues contain an active entry.
Canceling a rider already matched has no effect.
